benchmark_method.timing_scope: Source construction, offsets, first-stage all-four Boolean, replay clip construction, and semantic preflights are outside each timed loop. Timed operations rebuild either later public intersection evidence or one later all-four Boolean batch.
benchmark_method.perf_command: taskset -c 11 perf stat -x, -e cycles,instructions -- env HYPERCURVE_COMPARE_GROUP=algebraic_round_boolean/shared_chord_line_reentry HYPERCURVE_COMPARE_SAMPLES=1 HYPERCURVE_COMPARE_ITERS=256 HYPERCURVE_COMPARE_IMPL=<implementation> <comparative-executable>
benchmark_method.perf_normalization: Subtract the matched disabled process, then divide by 257 because Runner performs one warm-up operation before its 256 fixed timed iterations.
benchmark_method.heap_method: Heaptrack --record-only captures 16 fixed timed iterations. Subtract the matched disabled process and divide by 17 for the same one-operation warm-up.

benchmark_method.competitive_control: Cavalier Contours uses binary64 polylines, a floating first-stage intersection, and four separate Boolean calls against the clip; it is not exactness- or topology-equivalent.
